sessions.notes: Diagnostic baseline fluency, syntax, and placement assessment.
Icebreaking, elevator conversations, and spontaneous introduction.
Oral fluency drill, impromptu speech delivery, and tense accuracy.
Spontaneous narrative construction and complex tense consistency.
Compound, perfect, and conditional tenses in formal academic discourse.
Listening comprehension from dialogue audio, colloquial expressions, and role-play.
Idiomatic phrasing, register switching (formal vs informal), and active rebuttal.
Individual presentation delivery, body language, and slide structure critique.
Moderated team debates, argumentation, consensus building, and turn management.
Zero, first, second, and third conditionals in formal professional discourse.
Academic lecture note-taking, Cornell method, auditory comprehension.
Mixed conditionals, counter-argumentation, and corporate negotiation tactics.
